answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 39080 Country: Pakistan Title: I am worried about my sister's marriage Question: I am worried about my sister's marriage. Please let me know some dua. Also please do dua for me, so that I perform my fardh with the blessing of Almighty Allah. Answer ID: 39080 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1092/915/B=1433) Keep on reciting Ya Latif Ya Latif (يا لطيف يا لطيف) extensively and ask your sister to read Ya Jame’ Ya Jame’ (يا جامع يا جامع) extensively. In-shaAllah, soon any good proposal shall come. As for salah, first make firm intention then we shall pray for you. Only by formal dua you shall not turn namazi. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
